claims.claim: Draupadi is mentioned in the Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra.
claims.basis: The text is a comprehensive Jain hagiography by Hemachandra that covers the lives of 63 great figures, including those related to the Mahabharata era.

claims.claim: Jain tradition views the Mahabharata characters through the lens of karma and spiritual liberation.
claims.basis: Jain texts like the Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra provide a distinct perspective on the characters of the epic, focusing on their karmic journeys.
